name: Pebbulk at the campfire
notes: Pebbulk on the intro screen. It only shows once it is unlocked (unlocked >= 9) and sits on the half circle behind the fire: its seat depends on how many monsters are unlocked, all of them spread evenly from left to right in roster order, so with 9 unlocked it takes seat 9. It always looks at the fire (view per number unlocked: 9: left). When it is shiny it shimmers through the rainbow, like everywhere else.
